title: Slongo / Sunken Meadow
summary: Slongo is a recorded name associated with Sunk Meadow, now Sunken Meadow, in Smithtown. Its location is clear, but its linguistic origin remains unresolved and may not be Indigenous.
address_label: Sunken Meadow State Park, Kings Park, NY
map_geometry_source: Modern Sunken Meadow locality; the place is identifiable even though the name's origin remains unresolved.
activity_update_summary: Removed a short introduction that repeated the listing summary.
why_this_matters: Slongo is useful precisely because the map can separate a confident location from an uncertain origin. Publishing the record with that distinction prevents a historical name from being presented as confirmed Indigenous language when the available sources do not establish that conclusion.
history_content: Smithtown notes could not identify a derivation or living tradition for the name, and an earlier list questioned whether it might be Dutch. The origin remains unresolved.
translation_content: No secure translation is available. The origin remains uncertain, so the name should not be treated as a confirmed Indigenous placename.
preservation_content: Slongo is useful as a cautionary Tooker entry: not every name in historical lists can be safely published as Indigenous without stronger source support.
whereintheworld_content: The marker is placed at the Sunken Meadow landscape in Smithtown. It identifies the recorded locality, not a confirmed Native-language origin.
